brief:
Gaza's health ministry announced Thursday that the cumulative death toll from conflict in the enclave since October 2023 has reached 73,389, according to Shehab Wire. The figure includes a person killed in a strike on the northern Gaza Strip.

The updated count reflects ongoing Israeli military operations across the territory. Health officials in Gaza have been documenting casualties throughout the fourteen-month period of fighting.
